'''Skako''' was a [[planet]] in the [[Skako system]] in the [[Core Worlds]] region of [[the galaxy]] which was the [[homeworld]] of the [[Sentience|sentient]] [[Skakoan]] [[species]]. It had a high-pressure [[methane]] [[atmosphere]] that was unpleasant or deadly to offworlders. Using the methane and Skako's plentiful metallic resources, the technology-focused Skakoans covered the planet in industry and turned it into an [[ecumenopolis]]. For many [[Millennium|millennia]] it remained disconnected from the [[Galactic Republic]] due to the Skakoans' xenophobic and isolationist tendencies, but eventually the Skakoan [[Foreman]] [[Wat Tambor]] of the [[Techno Union]] became de facto representative of the world and its people in the [[Galactic Senate]].

During the [[Clone Wars]], the world indirectly supported the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]], due to Tambor's allegiance with them. As a consequence, it was [[Capture of Skako|captured]] by the Republic. Following the end of the war, the [[Galactic Empire]] placed emigration restrictions on Skako and caused its people to suffer greatly, although many Skakoans were happy to remain isolated from the galaxy on Skako.

==Description==
Located in the [[Skako system]] in grid square L-9 on the [[Standard Galactic Grid]],<ref name="Appendix" /> the [[planet]]<ref name="FO" /> Skako sat between [[Brentaal IV|Brentaal]] and [[Fedalle]] on the [[Hydian Way]] [[hyperspace route]].<ref name="Map" /> The world had a high-pressure [[methane]] [[atmosphere]] that to offwordlers was uncomfortable at best and deadly at worst, with even non-native methane breathers finding the pressure unpleasant. Rich in metallic resources, Skako was developed into an [[ecumenopolis]] by the technology focused [[Skakoan]] [[species]] native to the world. The planet's dense upper atmosphere consisted of an alkaline haze due to [[Star|solar]] strikes.<ref name="FO" />

==Behind the scenes==
Skako was first mentioned in the new ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] in a featurette<ref name="Liberty on Ryloth featurette">{{HomeVideoCite|set=Star Wars: The Clone Wars The Complete Season One|episode=Liberty on Ryloth}}</ref> included in [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars The Complete Season One|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' The Complete Season One]], a box set available on [[Wikipedia:Blu-ray|Blu-ray]] or [[Wikipedia:DVD|DVD]] that included the entire [[The Clone Wars: Season One|first season]] of the canon animated series ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]''<ref name="The Complete Season One">[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars The Complete Season One|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' The Complete Season One]]</ref> that was released on [[November 3]], [[2009]].<ref name="Star Wars: The Clone Wars The Complete Season One release date">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/news20090715.html|text=''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' The Complete Season One on DVD and Blu-Ray}}</ref> The world was then pictured for the first time in [[Star Wars: The Force Awakens Beginner Game|''Star Wars: The Force Awakens'' Beginner Game]], a roleplaying game released by [[Fantasy Flight Games]] in [[2015]].<ref name="Beginner Game">[[Star Wars: The Force Awakens Beginner Game|''Star Wars: The Force Awakens'' Beginner Game]]</ref> The world originated in the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, where it was created for ''[[Cloak of Deception]]'', a [[2001]] novel written by [[James Luceno]].<ref name="Cloak of Deception">''[[Cloak of Deception]]''</ref>

The similarly named world of [[Skako Minor]] was introduced to canon by the "[[Clone Force 99|Bad Batch]]" arc of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series,<ref name="Bad Batch">{{TCW|The Bad Batch (episode)}}</ref> which was originally released as unfinished production reels in [[2015]].<ref name="SW.com">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-clone-wars-bad-batch-recon|text=''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' "Bad Batch" Recon|nolive=1}}</ref> During the episodes set on Skako Minor, characters refer to the world as just "Skako" several times,<ref name="Distant Echo">{{TCW|A Distant Echo}}</ref> and Anakin Skywalker referred to Skako Minor as "Skako" in the [[2019]] book ''[[Choose Your Destiny: An Obi-Wan & Anakin Adventure]]''.<ref name="Obi-Wan and Anakin">''[[Choose Your Destiny: An Obi-Wan & Anakin Adventure]]''</ref> However, the [[2018]] role-playing supplement [[Fully Operational (sourcebook)|''Fully Operational'']] clarified that Skako and Skako Minor were separate worlds.<ref name="FO" /> A trivia gallery caption in the episode guide for the episode "[[A Distant Echo]]" also erroneously describes Skako Minor as "home" of the Skakoan people, rather than Skako.<ref name="Guide">{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/a-distant-echo-episode-guide|text="A Distant Echo" Episode Guide | The Clone Wars}}</ref>
